scope: Offline reconciliation of pinned upstream source accounting, current GCP registration and individual review-receipt availability; no new native execution or full compliance equivalence certification.

independent_offline_cache_verification.method: audit_gcp_source_parity.verify checked exact allowlisted file sets, Git blob SHA1 and SHA256; enumerate_sources reparsed all control/evaluator bodies and shared SQL without executing upstream code. All766 IDs, source URLs/blobs/revisions and evaluator/resolved hashes equal the preserved inventory.
independent_offline_cache_verification.network: socket, getaddrinfo and create_connection blocked; no fetch/clone/auth/cloud call

findings.qualification: These empty accounting/claim lists do not certify every upstream predicate equivalent or every service fully covered. All current529 predicate bodies match recorded current bindings; historical whole-module pins remain predecessors, not repinned current evidence. Mapped-active is lineage/related native availability only.

baseline_delta.reason: Four useful optional content additions and four explicitly unsupported historical contracts excluded; current active total remains422. The four new readers have independent native receipts and do not invent upstream numbered equivalence.

corporate_identity_policy.source_criterion_assessment: The SQL compares user email domains against organization owner directoryCustomerId; the native requires an explicit trusted_domains list. Organization association does not identify every legitimate external user. An org-derived comparator is a useful advisory, not an equivalent corporate-identity verdict.
corporate_identity_policy.independent_recheck: All6 wrappers use the same organization-directoryCustomerId/email-domain comparator and INFO without org data. Native corporate-domain exclusion requires deliberate owner trust input; inferring all legitimate human domains from organization membership would invent policy.

api_key_declarations.source_criterion_assessment: API key inventory can establish key absence with complete pagination. The wrapper remains INFO; active key-absence natives are separate implementations, so this report proposes reviewed requirement association rather than claiming SQL semantic equivalence.
api_key_declarations.independent_recheck: Resolved pinned wrapper/shared evaluator body and explicit native active/excluded state rechecked; current related/successor predicate body and individual native/source receipt linked per ID. Original rationale and full-equivalence boundary retained.

mfa_bounded_successor.source_criterion_assessment: Directory users exposes enrollment and enforcement independently. At initial review the native implementation read isEnrolledIn2Sv only, so enrollment does not establish enforced MFA; external identities and incomplete group expansion also remain unresolved.
mfa_bounded_successor.independent_recheck: Resolved pinned wrapper/shared evaluator body and explicit native active/excluded state rechecked; current related/successor predicate body and individual native/source receipt linked per ID. Original rationale and full-equivalence boundary retained.

security_key_only_policy.source_criterion_assessment: Security-key-only enforcement is stronger than enrollment or enforced 2SV. Directory boolean fields do not identify the required authentication factor. Retain the attestation unless an authoritative per-admin security-key policy source is collected; existing MFA and super-admin separation checks do not establish this requirement.
security_key_only_policy.independent_recheck: All5 wrappers are INFO, not factor enforcement tests. Current MFA successor requires native enrollment and enforcement but cannot identify security-key-only enforcement, so the stronger source requirement remains explicitly unresolved.

appengine_https_declaration.source_criterion_assessment: Serving-version handler securityLevel is readable; active App Engine HTTPS check is a related declarative implementation. SECURE_ALWAYS declaration does not prove all custom-domain routing or runtime TLS behavior.
appengine_https_declaration.independent_recheck: Resolved pinned wrapper/shared evaluator body and explicit native active/excluded state rechecked; current related/successor predicate body and individual native/source receipt linked per ID. Original rationale and full-equivalence boundary retained.

mysql_admin_authentication.source_criterion_assessment: Cloud SQL users.list exposes account names and hosts, but not passwords or an authenticated database administrative-privilege test. The active mysql_admin_account_posture check covers readable account posture only; never claim that it proves no privileged authentication is possible.
mysql_admin_authentication.independent_recheck: Resolved pinned wrapper/shared evaluator body and explicit native active/excluded state rechecked; current related/successor predicate body and individual native/source receipt linked per ID. Original rationale and full-equivalence boundary retained.

postgres_logging_declarations.source_criterion_assessment: Cloud SQL settings.databaseFlags exposes log_min_messages. Related active PostgreSQL flag checks exist, but their exact accepted values and provider defaults must be compared with this versioned requirement; INFO is not a flag evaluator and logging configuration is not delivered-log evidence.
postgres_logging_declarations.independent_recheck: Resolved pinned wrapper/shared evaluator body and explicit native active/excluded state rechecked; current related/successor predicate body and individual native/source receipt linked per ID. Original rationale and full-equivalence boundary retained.

function_values_bounded_successor.source_criterion_assessment: The wrapper supplies no predicate, but Functions v2 exposes runtime and build environment maps. At initial review the native scanned credential-like variable names only; benign names can hold secret values. Add bounded local value scanning with redacted evidence and explicit coverage; do not fetch Secret Manager payloads or infer a clean workload from truncated content.
function_values_bounded_successor.independent_recheck: All4 wrappers are INFO. The separate current Function literal-value predicate validates bound scan projections and both pinned offline engine completions; its source/archive/Secret Manager adoption limits remain explicit rather than renaming a variable-name heuristic as content scanning.

access_transparency_signal.source_criterion_assessment: Recent Access Transparency entries can prove an observed signal. The active signal check correctly returns UNKNOWN when no events exist; provider personnel may not have accessed the project, so an empty log cannot prove that Access Transparency is disabled or enabled.
access_transparency_signal.independent_recheck: Resolved pinned wrapper/shared evaluator body and explicit native active/excluded state rechecked; current related/successor predicate body and individual native/source receipt linked per ID. Original rationale and full-equivalence boundary retained.

os_assessment_bounded_successor.source_criterion_assessment: OS Config vulnerabilityReports exposes package vulnerabilities and updateTime. Native patch checks are archived because they require an owner grace period; a separate native check can flag positive outstanding security updates with explicit observed-time evidence, while unreadable or stale assessments stay UNKNOWN.
os_assessment_bounded_successor.independent_recheck: All4 wrappers are INFO. The current OS Config successor binds native project/VM/report identities and assessment timestamps and tests positive fixable findings; assessment-time vulnerability evidence does not establish current installed/latest patches or an owner grace period.

bigquery_classification_policy.source_criterion_assessment: BigQuery table schemas expose column policy tags and governance annotations, so metadata coverage and bounded content discovery are automatable. Whether all data is correctly classified needs taxonomy and content semantics; do not treat arbitrary labels as proof. A separate advisory can enumerate unannotated columns without claiming full classification compliance.
bigquery_classification_policy.independent_recheck: Both exact wrappers resolve to constant INFO over gcp_project. The current classification native remains excluded because it requires approved tags and column scope; a simple unannotated-column inventory is useful advisory work, not a missing generic compliance PASS/FAIL.

custom_metadata_object_presence.source_criterion_assessment: The query tests metadata object non-null, not metadata.items, and skips gke-* names in the status branch. Object presence does not establish a security setting or secret absence; retain the rejection of this predicate, but startup-script/metadata secret content scanning remains independently useful.
custom_metadata_object_presence.independent_recheck: Cached SQL accepts metadata={} merely because metadata is non-null and skips gke-* by name. Neither condition proves security posture; current metadata literal-secret reader is a separate useful implementation, not parity with this rejected object-presence test.

non_security_preference.source_criterion_assessment: The query alarms unless quic_override is ENABLE. The API exposes NONE, ENABLE and DISABLE as supported transport choices; this predicate supplies no TLS-policy or authentication weakness. A minimum TLS policy check is a separate security predicate.
non_security_preference.independent_recheck: Resolved pinned wrapper/shared evaluator body and explicit native active/excluded state rechecked; current related/successor predicate body and individual native/source receipt linked per ID. Original rationale and full-equivalence boundary retained.

inverted_small_cluster_auto_upgrade.source_criterion_assessment: The SQL alarms when autoUpgrade=true and cluster current_node_count<3, contradicting its title, and uses cluster-wide size per node pool. Do not reproduce this inverted availability heuristic; node auto-upgrade configuration is independently automatable.
inverted_small_cluster_auto_upgrade.independent_recheck: Cached SQL raises alarm for autoUpgrade=true and cluster current_node_count<3, rather than a per-pool unsafe upgrade state. The rejected inversion is not copied; existing native node-auto-upgrade configuration/limited availability checks are separately reviewed.

governance_without_security_predicate.source_criterion_assessment: The query checks only whether the labels object is null, so an empty object or arbitrary label passes. No security classification key or enforced authorization rule is identified; labels presence cannot prove secure configuration.
governance_without_security_predicate.independent_recheck: Resolved pinned wrapper/shared evaluator body and explicit native active/excluded state rechecked; current related/successor predicate body and individual native/source receipt linked per ID. Original rationale and full-equivalence boundary retained.

appengine_version_policy.source_criterion_assessment: App Engine versions and traffic allocations are readable and can identify inactive or old versions. The upstream title provides no safe numerical version limit; report version inventory or owner-selected lifecycle policy rather than inventing a security PASS threshold.
appengine_version_policy.independent_recheck: Resolved pinned wrapper/shared evaluator body and explicit native active/excluded state rechecked; current related/successor predicate body and individual native/source receipt linked per ID. Original rationale and full-equivalence boundary retained.

perimeter_explicit_trust.source_criterion_assessment: The resolved shared SQL compares each non-project user/group/domain/service-account member against $1-$4 trusted-principal lists; only-project members produce INFO. IAM APIs expose bindings but do not establish organizational trust of every identity. Public principal detection is automatable separately; it does not replace the trust-list predicate.
perimeter_explicit_trust.independent_recheck: All18 resolved wrappers substitute table/resource columns into the same pinned SQL. $1-$4 are explicit trusted user/group/domain/service-account lists and project-only grants yield INFO; native IAM visibility cannot infer customer trust. Their current excluded per-ID contracts remain available without treating the exclusions as missing public-principal automation.

external_observation.source_criterion_assessment: The evaluator constructs shodan.Shodan(shodan_api_key) and calls api.host(address.ip) for EXTERNAL addresses. This useful third-party observation needs external credentials and internet-service data; native external-IP/firewall facts cannot prove Shodan indexing parity. Keep a separately enabled enrichment integration outside provider-read-only coverage rather than mark it semantically covered.
external_observation.independent_recheck: Resolved pinned wrapper/shared evaluator body and explicit native active/excluded state rechecked; current related/successor predicate body and individual native/source receipt linked per ID. Original rationale and full-equivalence boundary retained.

remaining_bounded_upstream_candidates.criterion: Enumerate unannotated BigQuery schema columns, including nested fields, only as a classification-coverage advisory with an explicit selected scope.
remaining_bounded_upstream_candidates.reason: The cached wrappers are constant INFO; no taxonomy, sensitivity or required-column roster is supplied. Tags alone cannot prove correct classification, and an untagged nonsensitive column is not inherently a security failure. No missing full-compliance implementation is claimed.

secret_surface_reconciliation.limit: Explicit exact task only; payload headers/body literals, no dispatch/lease/auth references/secret stores.
Selected SQL/JavaScript definition literals only, not all dataset data, external libraries or execution.

secret_surface_reconciliation.service: Dataproc selected referenced plain job source and cluster initialization action
secret_surface_reconciliation.limit: PySpark mainPythonFileUri, SparkR mainRFileUri, Hive/Pig/SparkSQL queryFileUri or exact config.initializationActions[index].executableFile; current native reference and selected latest GCS generation agree before/after. Captured reference bytes only; no executed/creation-time or dependency/JAR/archive claim.

secret_surface_reconciliation.reason: Full job environment literals are scanned; template/staged artifact source association, stable generation and referenced archive/JAR handling are not supplied by that reader. Generic selected GCS bytes do not establish a Dataflow-job association.

secret_surface_reconciliation.service: Batch referenced scripts and container images
secret_surface_reconciliation.reason: Script.text/environment/container command literals are scanned. Script.path is a host-file reference; source mounting and immutable image/source mapping require separate proof, rather than assuming every path is GCS.

secret_surface_reconciliation.service: Workbench notebook/files and referenced startup code
secret_surface_reconciliation.reason: Only native metadata/systemMetadata literals are scanned; notebook filesystem contents, disk files and referenced code are not fetched. A selected GCS copy is not proof of Workbench association or executed/current cells.

secret_surface_reconciliation.service: Cloud Run jobs/multi-container services and App Engine flexible image lineage
secret_surface_reconciliation.reason: Current deployed-image planner is scoped to selected supported single-container service active/tagged revisions. Explicit registry digest inspection exists independently; automatic lineage for jobs/multi-container/flexible images is not claimed.

Native selected Cloud Source Repositories and supported GCP registries exist. No arbitrary hosted VCS/registry URL or discovered credentials are followed; selected GCS does not establish external repository linkage.

secret_surface_reconciliation.service: Secret Manager/Cloud KMS/managed password retrieval/Kubernetes Secrets
secret_surface_reconciliation.reason: Intended credential storage is not itself a leak surface. No broad secret-payload/decrypt/password reader is proposed; leaked literal copies are assessed separately.

proof_limits: This dispatch reparsed pinned source and joined existing source/native receipts; it did not rerun all native matrices or perform live verification.

Individual native receipt rows retain historical defect/producer caveats; latest correction receipts and current predicate hashes identify their successors. An available receipt or a passing conservation gate is not proof of effective access, log delivery, runtime reachability or complete upstream compliance.
Parent/core GKE and node-pool records can use historical individual source/producer trace plus the exact current native module/acceptance receipt; the report explicitly labels this distinction.

The original43 CRM fake-body failures and all historic red receipts remain preserved. Root separately closed those exact nodes through145 meaningful tests in crm-native-response-body-compatibility-20261020.json; this audit does not reclassify the old red files as green.
Generic selected object/image readers cover chosen bytes only; native service source association requires a dedicated verified bridge.

gate.purpose: The existing tests separately conserve historical GCP sources and current provider rows; this one test adds exact current predicate/individual receipt/active-excluded/source-set joins. No cloud API calls or native content scans were made.
gate.development_failures: Two report-schema gaps exposed by the new test were corrected: blank recheck module cells now resolve exact linked per-ID tests, and per-ID dictionaries keyed by check ID are validated by their exact key. These were reconciliation-input handling errors, not runtime or historical native verdict changes.

native_proof_availability_summary.not_certified: Per-ID record and test availability plus current body identity; not an assertion that every source branch was rerun or that historic red reports are current green.
